text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is reporting on the results of the traffic calming poll undertaken on Old Park Road, between Ridge Hill Drive and Elm Ridge Circle. The poll provided a response rate of less than the 50 percent plus one ballot required by the traffic calming policy needed to confirm that there is a favourable consensus in the community to install speed humps on the subject section of Old Park Road. Accordingly, continuing the process to install speed humps on Old Park Road, between Ridge Hill Drive and Elm Ridge Circle, is not recommended.

The Toronto and East York Community Council directed: 1. The City Solicitor prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install four speed humps on Old Park Road, between Ridge Hill Drive and Elm Ridge Circle, generally as shown on Drawing No. 421G-2720, dated October 2017, attached to the report (January 12, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District; and 2. Transportation Services staff to take the necessary actions to reduce the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Old Park Road, between Ridge Hill Drive and Elm Ridge Circle (south intersection) when the speed humps are installed.
